acceptedOriginals.caption:
Anzac Memorial, Brisbane, ca. 1939
This view of the Anzac Memorial at Anzac Square in Brisbane includes the stairs, brickwork, columns, railing and lighting. There is a view of the Central Railway Station and clock tower in the the background.

originalReview.notes: Individually inspected exact1000x609 native SLQ/John Oxley archive photograph, circa1939,item10462/deriv/92893, explicit PD-Australia/StateLibQld release, photographer genuinely unrecorded. Front axial view establishes18-column open-sky rotunda, continuous raised drum/crypt retaining body, twin wrapping stairs, broad central straight flight, sandstone wing retaining walls, coping/piers/period lamps and shallow reflecting pools. It does not establish current gallery interiors/hidden entry geometry or exact2026 repairs. CentralStation, historiccaption, memorial inscriptions/relief sculpture, trees/people excluded.
